# PATCH /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/pin/{position}

Move a pinned issue to a new position

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-378`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| index | path | int64 | True |
| position | path | int64 | True |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — User lacks write permission
- **404** — Issue not found
- **500** — Database error or position < 1

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | repo.MoveIssuePin | controller | Get issue by index; Call issues_model.MovePin |
| 2 | [models](../modules/models.md) | issues_model.MovePin | service | Validate position >= 1; Get issue pin; Shift other pins up/down; Update pin_order for target |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Pin position must be >= 1 | validation | newPosition < 1 |
| Moving pin reorders other pins - shifts up or down depending on direction | business_logic | issuePin.PinOrder > newPosition (moving to lower position) |
